entities.summary: Vladimir Mikushevich was a Russian poet, translator, and philosopher. He died on 23 October 2024, at the age of 88. He graduated from the Moscow State Institute of Foreign Languages and worked as a lecturer at the Moscow Literary Institute and the Institute of Journalism and Literary Creation.
